mentions.name: CrateDiggr
mentions.description: A Chrome and Firefox browser extension for SoundCloud that highlights free downloads in the SoundCloud UI and automatically clicks through the download gates (like, comment, repost requirements) for users, making it easier to find and download free tracks.
mentions.problem: Artists make users jump through hoops (liking, commenting, reposting) before granting access to free downloads on SoundCloud.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a Chrome (& Firefox) extension to make finding and downloading Free DLs on Soundcloud easier.

https://cratediggr.com/

Artists make users jump through hoops to like, comment, repost etc.. before giving them access to the download - CrateDiggr highlights the free downloads in the Soundcloud UI and clicks through the download gates for users.
mentions.author: finlayson_point
